checked_by: Claude, re-reading every stated fact from the tools (match_overview, death_context, build_check, pro_item_choices); the owner delegated the check
source: Tool outputs on the trace rebuilt from the archived replay, with the match record. A game the player won (45:22): the rubric is what is worth changing in a win, and that the review knows it was one.

must_hit.says: Five of the six deaths (9:05, 20:02, 23:53, 31:55, 35:02) came with three or more enemy heroes dealing damage. The team won 15 of 18 fights and Ursa's 6 deaths were the joint fewest on the team, so how those five happened is what there is to change.

No Black King Bar all game, while the damage in the death windows was mostly abilities and items (Pudge 22%, Spectre 19%, Shadow Shaman 14%, Tidehunter 11%) and the enemy had Shackles, Hex, Ravage and Dismember. 53% of 111 professional Ursas (7.41f) have it by 24:59.

must_not.says: Ursa's team won. In 7 of 32 parsed games the Ancient's kill row names no side, and until 2026-11-25 both teams were then told they had lost: a review of a win must not say the game was lost.
